snippet.title: Hunter's Moon: A Sovereign Syndicate Adventure Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: A Victorian Steampunk Roguelike Deckbuilder. Choose from four characters with unique cards and abilities. Customize your deck and character as you investigate a mysterious plague. Battle corrupted beasts and bosses in turn-based combat to unlock powerful relics and enchanted tarot cards.  Takes place in the Sovereign Syndicate world created by Crimson Herring Studios, now a part of Zugalu Entertainment.
